review_candidates.title: Senior Data Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Responsibilities Design, build and maintain reliable data pipelines, warehouses and lakehouse solutions. Develop and maintain shared data models that support business, product and regulatory requirements. Embed data governance and regulatory requirements into pipelines and datasets, including schema validation, access controls and auditability. Evaluate engineering tools and implementation options against agreed architecture, workload requirements, maintainability and cost. Requirements 7+ years
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a senior individual contributor role requiring deep technical expertise and the ability to independently drive complex implementations through production operation. Develop and maintain shared data models that support business, product and regulatory requirements. Embed data governance and regulatory requirements into pipelines and datasets, including schema validation, access controls and auditability. Evaluate engineering tools and implementation options against agreed architecture, workload requirements, maintainability and cost. Requirements 7+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, data warehousing or data platforms, including hands-on technical leadership. Strong hands-on experience with cloud data platforms, such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, Databricks, Snowflake or equivalent AWS/GCP services, including integration, orchestration, storage, security
